items.title: Penguin Colony review – an Antarctic odyssey of Nazis and Lovecraftian horrors
items.excerpt: PC; Origame Digital This odd but absorbing adventure sends you waddling across Antarctica in search of an eldritch entity – uncovering a world far stranger than it first appears A Nazi kneels down on frozen snow, staring at an endless Antarctic horizon. Another holds a gun to his head, ready to end his own life. I direct a small waddling penguin up to them, trying to imagine what it could be thinking. Dismay, perhaps. Likely bewilderment. But then a faint smile seems to break out across its beaky face, as if amused by these silly humans and their misguided belief that they could ever best this howling, harsh landscape. For most games, the idea of playing as a penguin observing Nazis losing the plot near the south pole would be weird enough. But Penguin Colony, developed by Origame Digital, pushes further. This is an audacious, frequently brilliant retelling of HP Lovecraft’s 1936 novella At the Mountains of Madness, in which eldritch horrors are just as common as Nazis. Further weirdness abounds: the many collectibles scattered about this place are not shiny gold objects à la Super Mario or Sonic. Rather, they are words. So tottering about as a semiaquatic bird, you have a unique mission: collect human language. Continue reading...

Slated for October 21, 2023, the IPO aims to attract around $3.2 billion. With shifting investor perspectives, particularly among the younger demographic who favor immediate profits over long-term investments, Jio's valuation is being closely examined alongside rivals like Bharti Airtel.

items.title: US stocks: US market ends down sharply; worries about AI trade and high oil prices weigh
items.excerpt: Wall Street faced a sharp decline on Friday as AI-related technology stocks came under renewed pressure. Concerns regarding debt-laden AI infrastructure companies affected investor sentiment heading into the weekend. Additionally, a rise in oil prices fueled market fears about economic stability and rising borrowing costs. The S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq all recorded substantial losses amid these uncertainties.

items.title: Big US bank stocks head for longest weekly losing streak since 2008
items.excerpt: Major US banks are experiencing their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis, driven by mixed quarterly earnings and rising inflation. The KBW Bank Index has fallen about 13% since its August peak, continuing a trend of losses. Concerns about artificial intelligence disrupting financial services contribute to the negative sentiment toward the sector. Analysts highlight challenges involving elevated interest rates potentially slowing economic growth.

items.title: Chip selloff deepens Wall Street losses as doubts grew over AI returns
items.excerpt: A significant selloff in semiconductor stocks affected major US indexes amid rising concerns regarding AI investment returns. The Nasdaq 100 dropped by 1.8%, continuing its longest losing streak since 2008. Market participants are questioning if AI infrastructure investments will yield profitable returns despite strong demand for chips. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh maintained a neutral stance on interest rates during discussions at the IMF meetings.

items.title: CoreWeave stock wipeout exposes divide between AI fear and greed
items.excerpt: CoreWeave Inc. is navigating turbulent stock trends due to climbing bond yields and investor trepidation over its debt, raising fears of default. Although a temporary boost followed optimistic comments from Nvidia's CEO, the overall sentiment leans towards caution. Analysts believe that while funding needs are pressing, robust AI demand could mitigate rate worries. Furthermore, CoreWeave's alliance with Nvidia may be a vital source of financial support in these unpredictable conditions.

items.title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd Q2 Results: Profit surges 65% to Rs 124 crore

items.title: US stocks: S&P 500 muted as AI concerns hit chip stocks; bank gains lift Dow

Concerns about debts of companies like CoreWeave intensified following steep declines in AI stocks. items.title: DLF Q2 profit rises to Rs 1,301 crore as luxury project sells out

items.title: Rupee rises 1.9% in a week, closes below 95 per dollar

items.title: Federal Bank Q2 profit jumps 45% to record Rs 1,386 crore

items.title: Aggressive RBI measures hand India bonds a ninth weekly loss

The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield has climbed over 62 basis points during this period, reflecting investor concerns. items.title: SpaceX just delivered some very strange cargo to the International Space Station

items.title: This bird flies thousands of miles, but its wings have a catch

items.title: Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline
